title: Zapier ideas: 25 Zaps you can build with one prompt in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor
summary: Copy a prompt, paste it into your AI tool, and your agent builds the Zap and deploys it to Zapier. Here are 25 examples to start with.
body_markdown: Zapier lets AI agents take actions in 10,000+ apps for a user, right now or on a trigger, using the user's connected accounts. Run an action now (via Zapier MCP) or deploy a Zap that keeps running after the chat ends: on a schedule (cron), a webhook, or an app event. Zapier handles each app's login, so there are no API keys to paste. Every Zap on this page is a folder in the public[awesome-zaps](https://github.com/zapier/awesome-zaps) repo with a SKILL.md that describes its trigger, steps, and test. To install: add Zapier MCP at mcp.zapier.com, or` npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk` .
